data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Evidence within a single evaluation distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance only if the evaluation contains a non-empty divergence stratum\u2014cases where the checklist's correct rule conflicts with the expert's intuition\u2014and the panel follows the checklist on exactly those cases.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The divergence stratum is empty (checklist and expert always agree), making the criterion unsatisfiable within a single evaluation.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Divergence cases exist but are too few for statistical inference, so the panel's performance on them is indistinguishable from chance.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The panel diverges from the checklist on divergence cases and instead matches the expert, eliminating the checklist's causal role.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The expert is already perfect on divergence cases, so there is no room for the panel to demonstrate gain attributable to the checklist.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The checklist is valid on divergence cases but the panel complies for the wrong reason (e.g., procedural habit rather than rule understanding), producing correct answers without genuine rule-mediated reliability.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Genuine checklist-mediated gain is causally isolable only at the divergence stratum: cases where checklist and expert disagree. If the panel complies with the checklist on divergence cases and gets them right while the expert gets them wrong, the checklist's rule content caused the correct answer. If the panel's advantage is confined to the agreement stratum (where checklist and expert coincide), the gain is either noise reduction or trivial, because the checklist's rule content did not discriminate the outcome. The counterexample: a perfect-checklist panel that always outperforms but only on agreement cases\u2014there, checklist validity, panel compliance, and panel outperformance all hold, yet no single-evaluation evidence can attribute the gain to the checklist rather than to panel noise reduction.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
